settings.sheetDesc: Make changes to your settings here. Click Save when you're done.

storePinnedTabs.title: Store Pinned Tabs
storePinnedTabs.desc: Store pinned tabs when adding a group. Disabled by default.

storeBrowserGroup.title: Store Browser Tab Group
storeBrowserGroup.desc: Store browser tab groups as separate new groups. Disabled by default.

defaultLockGroup.title: Default Lock Group
defaultLockGroup.desc: Lock a group by default when adding it. Disabled by default.

openGroupInNewWindow.title: Open Group In New Window
openGroupInNewWindow.desc: Open a group in a new window when restoring it. Disabled by default (opens in the current window).

useGoogleIcon.title: Load Icon From Google
useGoogleIcon.desc: The icon will be loaded from Google only if it is not cached. Disabled by default.

isStartupPage.title: Set as Startup Page
isStartupPage.desc: Automatically open TabClip as the home page every time you start your browser.

pageSize.title: Page Size
pageSize.desc: The number of TabGroups loaded each time.

truncateGroups.title: Delete Groups
truncateGroups.descLeft: This will delete all your tab groups. Type

importGroups.dialogDesc: Import the data exported from TabClip/Onetab.

file.label: Exported File
file.desc: The file exported from TabClip/Onetab extension (JSON, max {maxSize}).

firefoxNotAllow.toastTitle: Firefox Doesn't Allow Opening This Type of Tab
firefoxNotAllow.toastDesc: The link has been copied to your clipboard, please paste it manually into the address bar to visit.

firefoxNotAllow.toastTitle: Some Tabs Cannot Be Opened in Firefox
firefoxNotAllow.toastDesc: This tab group contains tabs that Firefox does not allow to open. The group will be preserved.

add.dialogDesc: Add a category. Click save when you're done.

update.dialogDesc: Edit the category. Click save when you're done.

edit.duplicateError: Duplicate category names are not allowed.

deleteCategory.dialogDesc: Only the category will be deleted — the tab group data associated with it will not be removed.

deleteCategoryAndGroups.dialogTitle: Delete Category '{categoryName}' and Its Associated Tab Groups?
deleteCategoryAndGroups.dialogDesc: This will delete the category and all its associated tab groups, including any that are locked.

merge.dialogDesc: Merge the original category into the new one. All tab groups from '{categoryName}' will be moved into '{categoryToName}' and '{categoryName}' will be removed.

veeValidate.fileSize: File size must be less than {maxSize}
